blocks.text: Yeh chapter entrepreneurship ke zaroori concepts aur skills ka poora overview (jaiza) deta hai. Yeh entrepreneurship ke taaruf aur innovation, problem-solving aur value creation (logon ke liye faida aur qeemat paida karna) ki ahmiyat se shuru hota hai. Phir Design Thinking batata hai, jo human centered (insan ki zaroorat ko sab se aage rakhne wala) hal banane ka tareeqa hai, aur tafseel se batata hai ke business plan kaise banta hai, market analysis aur financial forecasting (aage ke paise ke andaze) samait. Is mein market insights jama karna, ideas pitch karna aur marketing aur sales ki strategies lagu karna bhi shamil hai. Financial management (paise ka intezam), achhi communication aur collaboration ko karobar ki kamyabi ke aham hisse ke taur par samjhaya gaya hai. Aakhir mein chapter innovation aur creativity ko encourage (hosla afzai) karta hai aur students ko apna karobar (venture) shuru karne aur chalate rehne ke tools deta hai.

items: Users ko samjhein (Design Thinking), business plan banayein, market ko jaanein, achhi pitch karein, paisa sambhalein, achhi communication, collaboration, iteration aur innovation.
